comment: The components shipped in, or compiled into, a Virtual Serial Studio build. The About window's Licences tab is built from this file, and the 'Linked or built against' table in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md must list the same components (the test 'support: licences match the bundled components' checks both). A component that is not shipped does not belong in components; it goes in not_shipped.

components.name: Qt 6
components.shipped: The release packages carry the Qt libraries and plug-ins beside the program (qt_generate_deploy_app_script in apps/vss_gui/CMakeLists.txt).

components.name: Boost
components.shipped: Header-only libraries (Asio, System, JSON) compiled into every program.

components.name: Boost.VirtualSerial
components.shipped: Header-only library compiled into every program.

components.name: Tracy
components.shipped: Compiled in only when the build finds the vcpkg package. The release packages are not built with vcpkg, so they do not contain it.

not_shipped.reason: An optional Windows driver the user installs separately. Nothing of it is in the packages.
